title: Owner tries the stuck video on the machine where it happened
goal: Run the B-045 owner check and reply with the browser, the click pattern and the console line, or not reproduced
acceptance: The owner replies not reproduced, or names the browser, the click pattern and the console line
privacy: The owner's reply is recorded without coordinates, addresses or private flight data
validation: The owner's dated reply in the record
escalation: A reproduction goes back to B-045-T01 with a failing case before any fix

effort.basis: A few minutes of timeline clicks on the live site and one console line. Estimated 2026-11-26; estimate, not a measurement.
